subject: Goal pact: owners agreement & QBR readout plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-leads@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Goal pact: owners agreement & QBR readout plan

Team —

As discussed in leadership sync, we need a tight owners matrix and a short readout runbook for the Nov QBR. I put together a first-pass owners spreadsheet and a draft readout agenda (attached). Can you do the following by EOD Fri (Oct 30)?

- Confirm primary and backup owners for each objective in the sheet (column: primary / backup).
- Call out any hard blockers or cross-team dependencies.
- Confirm a 45–60 minute prep rehearsal slot the week of Nov 3 if we need it.

Key constraints:
- Readout slides must be <10 slides per objective.
- We need a canary metric and rollback criteria for any rollout tied to the OKR owners. Mina, Marcus — please advise if your teams have bandwidth to do the canary instrumentation by Nov 5.

Attachments: owners-commitments-draft.xlsx (owners matrix, v0)

Thanks — I want to consolidate changes into owners-commitments.xlsx and circulate the final readout deck on Nov 1 morning.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product & GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal pact: owners agreement & QBR readout plan

Karthik — thanks for the clear ask. I've reviewed the owners sheet and made three suggested edits (metrics normalization, consolidate two sub-objectives, and add a risk row). I've attached a short readout draft to align on flow.

High level notes:
- For Objective A (latency-cost tradeoff), suggest we measure p99 + cost/oppty rather than just p95.
- For Objective B (dedicated rollout), the timeline is tight if we need additional security review — flagging Susan from Acme as an external partner that will need a brief sign-off.

Proposed prep: Tue Nov 3, 1:00–1:45pm for a dry run (calendar invite to follow).

Attachment: QBR-readout-v1.pdf (draft agenda + slide skeleton)

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. I've merged everyone's edits and attachments into the master files (links below). Key updates:

- Owners: primary/backup columns populated; Maya is added as a backup for Marcus.
- Metrics: switched Objective A to p99 + cost/oppty per Laura's note.
- Canary: Mina's plan accepted; infra will provision hooks on Oct 31.
- External: Susan (Acme) will need a 15-minute partner sync during the QBR slot — Laura, please coordinate the invite.

Files: owners-commitments.xlsx (master), QBR-readout-final.pdf (slide deck, vFinal)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drives/folders/1A2B3C-okr-qbr

Action: Please reply to this thread with a single-line "SIGNED" or "NEEDS CHANGE" by 5:00pm PST today (Nov 1). If no changes are requested I'll circulate the final readout deck to execs at 6pm.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.
